product_summary: NOVELIC India Private Ltd (Chennai, Tamil Nadu; CIN U29301TN2025FTC186474, GST 33AALCN0457C1ZS per novelic.com/contact) is the Indian arm of Serbian NOVELIC d.o.o. (Belgrade, founded 2012/2013), announced 01.04.2026 (novelic.com news 'NOVELIC announces expansion into the Indian market'). Real product lines listed on novelic.com: (1) mmWave radar sensors/modules — ACAM200 60 GHz in-cabin monitoring radar, vital-signs monitoring sensor, volumetric anti-theft sensor, ASPER 79 GHz 180-deg automotive radar platform, AGERA 79 GHz ultra-short-range radar platform, RIOT100 24 GHz human-presence radar, ZORM 60 GHz industrial safety radar, ROAM 79 GHz radar for autonomous mobile robots, radar sensors for passenger/commercial vehicles and two-wheelers; (2) power electronics — on-board chargers 3.3/6.6/7.2/11 kW, battery management systems, vehicle control units, control units for power converters, Aurora Power HIL interface; (3) engineering/design services — embedded HW/SW, FPGA, HIL/SIL testing, mechanical CAD/CFD, sensor fusion, automotive radar testing, cybersecurity, semiconductor/IC design services and IP (hypr_risc RISC-V radar DSP, hypr_gate FPGA radar engine). The press release also states a 60 GHz radar production line was established in India in collaboration with parent Sona Comstar, producing in-cabin monitoring radar modules for a western Tier 1 supplier.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — group entity with own radar product design and a stated Indian 60 GHz radar production line, but also reselling/importing group-made modules and offering engineering services; no independent Indian manufacturing evidence beyond the group press release
comment: Declared 852610 (radar apparatus) is CORRECT for the core line: ACAM200, ASPER, AGERA, RIOT100, ZORM, ROAM and the in-cabin radar modules are all radar apparatus -> 852610. Status: partial, because the declared single code covers only part of the real catalogue. Missing from the declaration: 852691 (radio navigational aid apparatus — if ASPER/AGERA ADAS modules are declared as complete navigation/ADAS units rather than bare radar), 854370 (electrical machines/apparatus with individual function — presence/vital-signs sensing modules sold as standalone sensors), 850440 (static converters — on-board chargers 3.3–11 kW), 853710 (boards/panels for voltage <=1000 V — VCU, BMS control units, control units for power converters), 903180 (measuring/checking instruments — HIL/SIL test platforms, radar test and validation equipment). Industry claim 'IT и электроника' is a misclassification: the company is automotive/industrial electronics — mmWave radar sensors, power electronics and semiconductor design — i.e. automotive Tier-2/Tier-1 supplier plus engineering services, not IT. Trader signs: the entity is a 2025-incorporated foreign-owned subsidiary (CIN year 2025, FTC = foreign company) that imports/distributes group products into India and provides services; the only stated local production is via the Sona Comstar collaboration, not an own plant. All product and production claims are from the company's own website and press release only — no customs line was available to this check, so every product line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No HS mismatch rejection: company retained, code corrected/expanded as above.
